description: Sleep app landing: sky-blue palette, split hero with CSS phone mock, soft rounded cards, pill preview button.

referenceProfile.thesis: Calm is conveyed through a single sky-blue family: soft tints for surfaces, deep navy for text and store buttons, and generous radii on every element.
signatureMoves: A pure-CSS phone mock stands in for app screenshots, keeping the page asset-free.
Store buttons use the darkest navy so download reads as the page's one commitment.
transferPreserve: Stay inside the blue family, keep radii large, and let one dark button mark the primary action.
transferAvoid: Do not add warm accent colors, sharp corners, or dense feature tables.
